clientlogs.title: Upload client logs
clientlogs.prompt: Upload client logs to help server administrators investigate this crash or disconnect? Missing client logs makes bug diagnosis and server stability investigations harder.
clientlogs.files: Files to submit (previous: last archived session; tail: truncated):
clientlogs.details: Archive: about {0} KiB, including mod versions and file timestamps. Logs may contain chat, server addresses and local paths. Confirm to send them to this server's administrators. You can decline and use /clientlogs later.

ui.economy-rate-help:
1 coin = rate × current reference coins.
Price an unpriced currency before switching to it as reference.
ui.economy-select-reference: Choose any registered coin as reference, without minting your own. It is automatically recognized at rate 1.
ui.economy-legacy: Legacy coin registered by its Coinage designer; historical minting totals are unavailable.
ui.economy-reference-one: Reference currency is recognized at a fixed rate of 1.
ui.economy-no-own-coins: You can adopt another tribe's or a personal currency without minting your own.
ui.economy-offer-help: Only permitted offers can be traded. Your saved offers remain visible, with a red border when out of stock; buyers only see available offers. Look at another player and press Ctrl+T to trade. No held coin is required; offers can request items, coins, or both.
ui.economy-task-assigned: Task assigned. Meet your partner to confirm completion or cancellation.
ui.economy-offer-unavailable: Unavailable: check stock, rewards and recognized currencies.
ui.economy-stat-help: Minting totals start when this feature is enabled. Trade totals include only transactions completed here.
ui.economy-accountants: Members authorized to read the ledger
ui.economy-ledger-help: Shows current holdings and minted quantities, without transaction records.
ui.economy-ledger-total: Online balances {0} · Tribal minting {1} · Income {2} · Spending {3}
ui.economy-join-tribe: Join or create a tribe to configure tribal currencies. Personal trading does not require a tribe.
ui.economy-trade-expired: Trade ended: disconnected, too far away, or expired.
ui.economy-trade-cancelled: Trade cancelled; no items or coins transferred.
ui.economy-trade-done: Trade completed; items and coins transferred.
ui.economy-error: Economy save failed. Operation not completed; check the server log.
ui.economy-invalid: Amounts must be whole numbers from 1 to 1000000. Rates must be decimals from 0.000001 to 1000000. Choose a recognized currency.
ui.economy-policy-conflict: Only the leader can change this. Tribe or policy changed; refresh and try again.
ui.economy-reference-fixed: Reference currency must remain recognized at rate 1. Choose another reference first.
ui.economy-reference-required: First select any registered currency as reference, including an external currency.
ui.economy-reference-rate-required: Enter the value of 1 new reference coin in old reference coins before switching.
ui.economy-reference-range: Rebasing would put a rate outside 0.000001–1000000. Nothing changed; adjust recognized currencies and rates first.
ui.economy-cancel-reference-help: This clears all tribe rates and pauses currency recognition. Offers, tasks and history remain.
ui.economy-offer-conflict: Offer, task, permissions or rates changed. Start a new trade.
ui.economy-item-missing: You no longer carry this item. Offer was not saved.
ui.economy-unrecognized: Their tribe does not recognize your held currency.
ui.economy-trade-busy: You or your partner are already trading.

ui.economy-reselect-item: This offer's item cannot be resolved. Edit and select the goods again; quantity and price are retained.
ui.economy-confirm-help: Check the task details and reward. Both players must confirm.
ui.economy-issuer-conflict: Registration conditions changed or you lack permission. Refresh and try again.
ui.economy-offer-unavailable-short: Stock, funds or currency recognition unavailable
ui.economy-task-invalid: Enter a task title (up to 100 characters) and details (up to 2000 characters).

ui.economy-no-exchange-rate: No tribe has published a rate for these currencies.

ui.tutorial-limit: The tutorial limit has been reached.

ui.ground-map-support: Use a dry supporting block or furniture surface with clear space outside. Ctrl + right-click for a small map; right-click for an atlas. Top edges may drape down.
ui.ground-map-invalid: Only initialized ordinary papyrus and parchment maps can be placed.
ui.ground-map-disconnected: Maps must share material and dimension, and overlap or share an edge. Maximum 16 sheets per assembly.
ui.ground-map-controls: Ctrl + right-click: add a connected map. Hold Ctrl to lock an outline, then left-click to retrieve it. Offhand flax twine + main-hand bone needle: right-click to sew.
ui.ground-map-atlas-controls: Placed atlas: hold Ctrl to lock the whole outline, then left-click to retrieve it intact. Fixed coverage cannot accept more maps or be sewn again.
ui.ground-map-atlas-place: Right-click to attach the whole atlas to the top, side or underside of a block or furniture. Hold Ctrl and left-click to retrieve it intact, keeping markers and locks.
ui.ground-map-tools: Hold flax twine in your offhand and a bone needle in your main hand. Each overlapping or edge-sharing pair costs one twine. Additional twine is taken from your carried inventory.
ui.ground-map-thread-cost: Sewing requires {0} flax twine (one per overlapping or edge-sharing pair).
ui.ground-map-thread-short: Not enough flax twine: requires {0}, carrying {1}.
ui.ground-map-two: At least two connected maps are required.
ui.ground-map-locked: Unlock the maps before sewing or disassembling.
ui.ground-map-too-many-markers: Combined waypoint data exceeds the native map format. Remove some markers before sewing.
ui.ground-map-fixed: Fills the paper continuously at the original map scale, keeping you as close to the center as possible. The view stops at edges and gaps; your marker follows your actual position and hides outside the view. Only fixed stitched coverage is shown and refreshed automatically. Cannot be redrawn or expanded with a pencil. Markers inside this coverage may be pinned.
ui.ground-map-split: Hold this map in your offhand and a knife in your main hand, then right-click to recover the originals with current markers. Twine is not returned.
ui.map-marker-locked: Unlock the map before copying or pasting markers.
ui.map-marker-needs-tool: Hold a charcoal pencil in your offhand before copying or pasting markers.
ui.map-marker-empty: Copy markers from an unlocked map first.
ui.effect-homecoming: Let departed souls return home (home tribe destination chance after successful reincarnation: {0}%; 100% if no other tribe qualifies)
lore-restricted: This lore content is restricted by the server.
ui.auth-disabled: Tribe authorization is disabled by the server.
ui.auth-help: Chiefs and delegated members can authorize visitors by game name or by facing them. Chiefs can also assign member management rights. Duration is in minutes; -1 means permanent.
ui.auth-game-name: Current game name (blank: face a player within 3 blocks)
ui.auth-leader-help: Visitor authorization requires permission from your chief.
ui.auth-invalid-time: Enter positive whole minutes or -1 for unlimited (maximum 5256000 minutes).
ui.auth-no-scope: Select at least one scope enabled by the server.
ui.auth-name-not-unique: No unique current game name found. Use the full custom game name, not an account name or UUID.
ui.auth-face-player: Face a named player within 3 blocks or enter their current game name.
ui.auth-already-member: Tribe members already have these permissions.
auth-critical-area: Unauthorized placement near a tribe center is disabled.
ui.auth-contract-disabled: Parchment contract signing is disabled by the server.
ui.auth-contract-save-failed: Could not save the signed contract. Please try again later.
ui.auth-contract-invalid: Invalid first-line header. Example: [time=30, auth=build, name=Game Name]. Use build, benefits or both; positive whole minutes or -1.
ui.auth-contract-paper: Use one unsigned parchment, keep the original paper in place and a writing tool in your off hand. Bound contracts cannot be edited or signed again.
ui.auth-contract-transcribe: Contracts are bound to the original parchment. Ask the leader to write and sign a new contract instead of transcribing.
ui.economy-trade-target: Look at a tradable player within 5 blocks.
ui.adopt-help: Aim at a block within 5 blocks before opening this page. Both you and its placer need local construction rights. Adopts one block at a time.
ui.adopt-target: Aim at a building block within 5 blocks.
ui.adopt-denied: Both you and its recorded placer need local construction rights.
ui.adopt-excluded: This block is excluded from tribal reinforcement.
ui.adopt-done: The targeted block now belongs to the tribe.
ui.auth-member-permissions: Only the chief can grant these rights to tribe members. Leave unchecked for visitors.
ui.confirm-transfer-leader: Transfer leadership to {0}? Existing delegated management rights will be cleared for the new chief to reassign.
ui.confirm-remove-outpost: Delete outpost {0}? This area loses tribal territory benefits and starts the cooldown.
